title: Schedule of Cleaning and Damage Fees by Fee Level
content:
This schedule sets, for each Cleaning and Damage Fees level, how the fee is set and the amounts that bound it. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Fee level | How the fee is set | Flat fee | Receipt fee cap | Smallest receipt processed | Repair estimate enough to charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | Flat by level | $25.00 | $0.00 (flat level) | $0.00 (flat level) | Not applicable |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | Flat by level | $60.00 | $0.00 (flat level) | $0.00 (flat level) | Not applicable |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | Flat by level | $100.00 | $0.00 (flat level) | $0.00 (flat level) | Not applicable |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | Flat by level | $150.00 | $0.00 (flat level) | $0.00 (flat level) | Not applicable |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | The repair receipt amount | $0.00 (receipt-based level) | $350.00 | $25.00 | Yes, an estimate is enough |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | The repair receipt amount | $0.00 (receipt-based level) | $750.00 | $50.00 | Yes, an estimate is enough |

## Terms of the schedule

1. **Flat fee.** The fee charged to the rider at a flat level; a receipt-based level has a flat fee of $0.00.
2. **Receipt fee cap.** The most a receipt-based fee can charge the rider; a flat level has a receipt fee cap of $0.00.
3. **Smallest receipt processed.** The smallest receipt a receipt-based report is processed for; a flat level shows $0.00.
4. **Repair estimate enough to charge.** At both damage levels a repair estimate is enough to charge; a final repair receipt is not required. The question does not arise at the flat cleaning levels.
5. **Repair above the cap.** At every level, the part of a repair above the cap is never charged to the rider; the driver files it with the commercial auto insurance claim desk.
6. **Rounding.** At every level, every computed fee or refund is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end of its computation.
7. **When the card is charged.** At every level, the fee is charged to the rider's card on file when the assessment is approved.
8. **A fee that does not collect.** At every level, a fee that fails to collect stays on the assessment and is retried on the card on file; it never moves to trip charges.
9. **Net fee billed.** The net fee billed on an assessment is the cleaning or damage fee charged to the rider on that one assessment less refunds, in US dollars.

## Notes on the schedule

- The four cleaning levels are flat levels, and the two damage levels are receipt-based levels; no level is both.
- A figure of $0.00 under "Receipt fee cap" or "Smallest receipt processed" marks a flat level, and a figure of $0.00 under "Flat fee" marks a receipt-based level.
